liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ollin Arrageed** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer notes this 1985 performance was reportedly the last ever of the piece, with Matt Kelly present; Hamza El-Din plays with the band from Ollin Arageed through Man Smart (Woman Smarter) [2][14]
- **Deal** (1 other source): Minglewood went straight into Deal, but the transition was lost to a tape flip [7]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer hears this version as drippy and nice [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ollin Arrageed**: back after 431 archived shows (2047 days); rare: 14 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd85-03-13.sbd.barbella.9961.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 138 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Brent's poppy, clavinet-like keyboard tone comes through prominently on this soundboard; Listener likes how the first set sounds on this tape, especially Minglewood; Reviewer hears some audio problems at times, possibly from streaming, but finds the tape listenable [9][12][15][16][20]
- **gd1985-03-13.169168.sbd.marcus.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1985-03-13.senn421.mccue.ford.84490.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1985-03-13.nakcm300.32017.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 141 min [7]. Said about its sound: A patch-cord problem marred Jack Straw; repaired in software, and sound improves 35 seconds into Althea [7]

## Around the show

- Second set opens with The Music Never Stopped [14]
- Matthew Kelly joins on New Minglewood Blues, Deal, Spoonful and Black Peter [2]
- The show was a Rex Foundation benefit, with Matt Kelly and Hamza El-Din sitting in [6]
- Reviewer finds the second set an oddity, seeming to carry on the first set's style [12]
- Reviewer ranks it among the better 1985 shows heard so far [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd85-03-13.sbd.barbella.9961.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > DAT > CDR [1]. Also: Master soundboard cassette transferred to DAT, then CDR, via raul; seeded to etree by Steve Barbella [1]
- **gd1985-03-13.169168.sbd.marcus.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Steve Marcus; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Steve Marcus' Master Soundboard Cassettes > Sony WM-D6C (Maxell MX-90) [2]
- **gd1985-03-13.senn421.mccue.ford.84490.flac16**: taped by Mark McCue; transferred by Alex Ford; source: MAC; Sennheiser 421s > Sony D5 > TDK MA90 cassettes [6]. Also: Master audience cassettes from Mark McCue; transfer, edits and seeding by Alex Ford on 4/24/2007 [6]
- **gd1985-03-13.nakcm300.32017.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Nakamichi CM-300's w/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M, taper's section. Taped onto Maxell MX-90, with Dolby off for recording and playback [7]. Also: Two small cuts in Drums, from other decks being flipped, were repaired with Soundforge [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brian Baumwoll Grateful Dead: [1985-03-12 Berkeley Community Theater, Berkeley, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-03-12-berkeley-community-theater-berkeley-ca-usa/) [22]
